meta.name: Free Bert
meta.description:
A gloriously messy dad and his equally unfiltered family cause chaos when they try to fit in with the snobby crowd at their elite new school.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: The Crowd Pleaser
videos.overview: An existential crisis at a celebrity soiree pushes Bert to get more involved in his daughters' lives — with predictably disastrous results.

videos.title: Wearing Thin
videos.overview: Bert's attempt to transform campus conflict into comedy gold lands Georgia on house arrest, where a new face in her DMs sparks major parental concern.

videos.title: Nutless
videos.overview: It's sink or swim as Bert and LeeAnn scramble to polish their image at a posh poolside brunch — and undo their missteps with Georgia's crush.

videos.title: The New Fourth
videos.overview: Bert leverages a catastrophe to tee up a day out with the other Barklidge dads, leaving LeeAnn trapped in close quarters with a frenemy.

videos.title: A Doubt Firestorm
videos.overview: Cornered by an unexpected blackmailer, Bert must evade suspicion on a boys' trip. LeeAnn's half-baked cover-up starts to crumble.

videos.title: Proper Descension
videos.overview: As Barklidge prepares to crown its king and queen, the Kreischers must decide whether they're happier fitting in — or standing out.
